title: Home
description: The returning-user dashboard — genuinely missing before this pass. 12 other screens' bottom-nav 'Home' item pointed at discover/trending_recommended_sections as a stand-in; this is the real destination. IA is greeting -> activity counts -> Continue -> For you -> Recent activity -> secondary actions, per the brand owner's explicit wireframe: 'Home ≠ Dashboard... the returning-user home should say: here is what is happening in your MusicLinkd world, and here is the best next thing for you to do.'
